title: Cognitive Somatic Regulator
subtitle: Active Inference modeling applied to somatic regulation and threshold gating.
audience: Researchers and cognitive modelers exploring somatic feedback, ethical threshold gates, and neuro-somatic dynamics.
lede: Cognitive Somatic Regulator is an Ecosystem project exploring how Active Inference generative models can represent somatic regulation, ethical threshold gating, and neuro-somatic feedback loops.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: The project investigates somatic regulation architectures, ethical threshold mechanisms, and adaptive cognitive-affective dynamics within open cognitive frameworks.

sections.heading: Participate
sections.body: Collaborators interested in somatic feedback modeling, cognitive architectures, and ethical regulation are welcome to join community discussions.
